decisive_items: bilateral osteolysis of the mastoids, superior and lateral semicircular canals, and the right external auditory canal
separate osteolytic lesion in the dorsal left parietal bone
response.rationale: Multifocal lytic bone lesions including bilateral temporal bone destruction and a separate parietal skull lesion favor Langerhans cell histiocytosis; cholesteatoma is a local process and would not explain the distant parietal osteolytic lesion.

rejected.why: Cholesteatoma explains the aural polyp, otorrhea, and mastoid erosion, but not the separate osteolytic lesion in the left parietal bone or bilateral semicircular canal involvement.
